name: talk-html-plugin
description: Codex packaging for LiuShiyuMath/talk-html-plugin v0.4.0: turn conversation context into Chinese, evidence-grounded HTML one-pagers. v0.4 adds the talk-ship engine — end-to-end user journey capture (Playwright / tmux + asciinema → MP4 + contact sheet) folded back into a one-pager as the strongest ship evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Make recallable, shareable HTML one-pagers from a conversation.
interface.longDescription: Use talk-html from Codex to create Simplified Chinese HTML one-pagers grounded in real source material, preview them locally, publish them to GitHub Gist, and recall prior pages later.
defaultPrompt: 用 talk-html 把这段对话做成一页 HTML
把这个复盘发布成一个可分享的 HTML 页面
回看最近的 talk-html 页面
